rounds: If I started a company, I’d happily sell it for the right price.
I’d rather work for a small company than a big one.
A brand belongs more to its fans than to its owners.
Big companies mainly buy small rivals to stop them competing.
Most takeovers are about the boss’s ego, not the business.
Two companies with different cultures can never really become one.
Online anger about a takeover is usually forgotten within a month.
Paying billions for a company that makes no profit is crazy.
